top_signals.title: Trump floats renaming Strait of Hormuz the 'Trump Strait'
top_signals.summary: U.S. Energy Secretary Chris Wright told CNBC that more than 17 million barrels of oil transited the strait on Monday, a wartime record.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Yen Surge Puts Traders on High Alert for Official Action
top_signals.summary: A sharp rise in the yen during New York trading has put traders back on high alert for any evidence that authorities will return to the market following intervention in July.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.
